source.title: Offline Mode for the Field Inspections App

requirements.text: Inspectors must be able to download assigned inspections for offline use before leaving coverage.
details: The download includes checklists, prior findings and site documents.

section: Offline Mode for the Field Inspections App

requirements.text: The app must let inspectors fill in checklists, add notes and capture photos while offline.
details: All offline changes are stored locally and encrypted at rest.

section: Offline Mode for the Field Inspections App

requirements.text: When connectivity returns, the app must sync queued changes to the server automatically in the background.

section: Offline Mode for the Field Inspections App

requirements.text: Sync must resume after interruption without duplicating photos.

section: Offline Mode for the Field Inspections App

requirements.text: If the same inspection was edited on the server while the inspector was offline, the app must detect the conflict and let the inspector choose which version of each conflicting field to keep.

section: Offline Mode for the Field Inspections App

requirements.text: The app should show a clear offline indicator and the number of changes waiting to sync.

section: Offline Mode for the Field Inspections App

requirements.text: Inspectors could pre-fetch map tiles for assigned sites so directions work offline.

section: Offline Mode for the Field Inspections App

requirements.text: Offline storage must support at least 50 inspections and 2 GB of photos per device.

section: Offline Mode for the Field Inspections App

requirements.text: Local data must be encrypted with a key stored in the platform keystore.

section: Offline Mode for the Field Inspections App

requirements.text: Sync of a 20-photo inspection should complete within 3 minutes on a 3G connection.

section: Offline Mode for the Field Inspections App

outOfScope.text: Offline creation of new sites or new inspection templates.

epics.title: Offline Mode for the Field Inspections App
epics.description: Field inspectors use the mobile app at construction sites and rural facilities where signal is unreliable. When the connection drops, the app shows a spinner and inspectors lose notes and photos. Inspectors fall back to paper and re-type reports later.

risks.description: Conflict resolution UX may confuse inspectors and lead to the wrong version being kept.
Low-end Android devices may run out of storage with large photo sets.
Background sync is restricted by iOS and Android battery policies.
Unresolved question: How long should synced inspections remain cached on the device?
risks.mitigation: Resolve with the PRD owner before the related stories enter a sprint.
